items.text: Shared health badge helper — HealthBadgeUtils drives dashboard and config header badges (broken/warning counts, /health?filter=broken routing, badge DOM) from one module.
Config badge parity — config header warnings include shortcut conflicts (same as dashboard); badge refreshes when you return to the config tab after visiting health or the dashboard.
Live config sync badge — dashboard header health badge refreshes after live config structure sync (cross-tab bookmark edits), without switching tabs.
Queue numbering — post-onboarding discoverability starts at Tip 1 of 3 on the What's new modal (when unread), then layout-nudge and paste spotlights; Later this session on all three steps.

Config discoverability queue — What's new and layout-nudge also run when you open config first; paste spotlight stays dashboard-only; layout choices from the nudge save via config when no dashboard tab is open.
Queue reset on config — Advanced reset buttons for the discoverability queue and layout nudge replay the queue on the current config page.
Cache-bust — template query strings for whats-new-modal.js and health-badge-utils.js so Docker-mounted static files refresh without a hard reload.
GHCR image name — README and MANUAL use ghcr.io/jordibrouwer/nextdash (lowercase), matching GHCR and the Unraid template.
MANUAL — discoverability queue flow and Essentials Health → broken-filter routing documented.
Go test stability — tests use t.Chdir for temp directories so repeated go test -count runs no longer flake on cleanup.
